description: Read the QR code in a PNG image and decode it like vietqr_parse: bank, account, amount, note, CRC validity. Give exactly one of `path` (a file on the server) or `data` (base64 of the PNG, or a data:image/png;base64, URL; max 5 MB decoded, at most 20 megapixels). Returns INVALID_INPUT unless exactly one is given, TOO_LARGE over either cap, READ_ERROR for bad base64 or an unreadable/non-PNG image and NO_QR when no QR code is found.

data.description: Base64 PNG bytes, or a data:image/png;base64,... URL (max 5 MB decoded)

path.description: Path to a PNG image on the server

name: vietqr_decode
title: Decode VietQR image
